stops.name: Ramsau
stops.detail: At the entrance to the vast high-alpine valley between Mount Watzmann and Mount Hochkalter, near the mountaineering village of Ramsau, lies the narrow Wimbachklamm Gorge.

stops.name: Wimbachklamm Gorge
stops.detail: Wimbachklamm Gorge offers an unforgettable nature experience along bridges and wooden walkways.

stops.name: Berchtesgaden National Park
stops.detail: Wimbachklamm Gorge in Berchtesgaden National Park is a fascinating geological attraction, a spectacular natural landmark, and a popular destination for hikers and walkers alike.

stops.name: Wimbachgries
stops.detail: While the upper Wimbachtal valley, known as Wimbachgries, is covered in dry gravel and the water flows underground, the mountain stream bursts back to the surface in Wimbachklamm Gorge.

stops.name: Wimbachgrieshütte
stops.detail: Farther up Wimbachtal, Wimbachgrieshütte offers overnight accommodations and is a popular destination for hikers and mountaineers.
